text:
Derek: FYI team  StratusWave marketplace listing + joint integration launch on Oct 3. Main asks: landing + webinar, inbound lead routing that avoids double-touch, nightly partner drop format, and a micro-benchmark blurb for the launch blog. Who can take what?
June: I can own UTMs + landing copy. Use utm_source=stratuswave_market and campaign=STRAT-LAUNCH-1003. Add hidden field partner=stratuswave and campaign_code=SW-1003.
Rhea: Webinar ops: run-of-show idea: 10m intros, 25m live integration demo, 10m customer example, 15m Q&A. Need speaker bios and a 5-slide case study. Also we should schedule a dry run on 9/29.
Marco: Partner wants webhook if DPA signed; fallback nightly SFTP PGP CSV. They asked for a separate file for webinar engagement events (join, watch_pct). For security, HMAC header on webhooks.
Derek: Routing rules draft:
- partner_opt_in=true AND role in (Engineer, Integrations, DevRel) -> partner queue (real-time if webhook else nightly)
- lead_score >= 70 OR enterprise_domain -> Redwood AE handoff + notify partner (no auto-ownership transfer)
- webinar_attended=true and watch_pct>=50 -> +25 to lead_score and re-evaluate routing
- all others -> co-branded nurture stream (segmented dev vs product).
June: For ads, primary CTA = Register for webinar; secondary = Try dev sandbox. Add utm_content to separate headline variants. Put final UTMs in tracking doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/stratuswave-launch
Rhea: Consent handling: partner_share checkbox default unchecked. Legal-approved copy required. Add consent_timestamp to CSV for auditing.
Marco: Nightly CSV schema (sample header) I propose:
```
email,first_name,last_name,company,region,role,partner_opt_in,utm_source,campaign_code,hs_contact_id,sfdc_contact_id,lead_score,consent_timestamp,first_touch_channel,webinar_registered,webinar_attended,watch_pct
```
Derek: Also include a small `initial_touch_ts` and `campaign_ref` field so partner can attribute first-touch correctly. June: can we add campaign_ref to hidden fields?
June: Yes. I'll add campaign_ref=SW-1003-ads or SW-1003-market depending on source.
Rhea: Benchmark blurb idea: two-scenario micro-benchmark comparing a single-node baseline vs Redwood+StratusWave routing with batching + KV-cache. Method: same 60 prompts, 10 warmups, report median p50/p95 and $/1k tokens. Keep the paragraph short and include a reproducible script link. I'll draft the 3-paragraph blurb.
Marco: I'll upload PGP public key and a `stratuswave-sample-nightly.csv` once keys are provisioned. Also will provide sample webhook payload in spec (HMAC header example).
Derek: Assignments: June = UTMs + landing + ad CTAs (due 9/10), Rhea = webinar page + run-of-show + benchmark blurb (due 9/15), Marco = partner delivery spec + PGP keys + sample CSV + webhook spec (due 9/12). I'll coordinate partner comms and assemble co-branded nurture.
ops-bot: Event created: "StratusWave launch ops sync" 9/20 10:00am PT -> https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/stratuswave-launch-sync
June: Quick note on headline variants for A/B testing: A) "Ship integration-ready inference with Redwood + StratusWave" B) "Lower inference latency and cost for product teams  Redwood + StratusWave". We'll test A on dev channels and B on SEO/blog.
Rhea: One operational wrinkle  avoid double-touch by setting a 7-day lock: if partner was first-touch, do not auto-assign AE within 7 days unless lead_score >= 85. Derek: good call, add to routing doc.
Derek: Please drop HubSpot/Marketo workflow screenshots and the sample CSV into the tracking folder before the 9/20 sync. Thanks everyone :rocket:
